# ADR-3273: AWS tagging_compute: Mandatory cost allocation tag setting for account 1

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Untagged resources hide owners and cost.

## Decision

Accounts MUST enforce a mandatory cost allocation tag setting for account 1 (AWS-tagging_compute-1).

## Consequences

SCPs or Config rules enforce keys.
